result.content:
name: Autonomous Integration Fabric

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'integration/**'
      - 'security/runtime/bootstrap.cjs'
      - 'Dockerfile'
      - '.github/workflows/autonomous-integration-fabric.yml'
  push:
    branches:
      - 'feature/autonomous-integration-fabric-v1'
    paths:
      - 'integration/**'
      - 'security/runtime/bootstrap.cjs'
      - 'Dockerfile'
      - '.github/workflows/autonomous-integration-fabric.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: autonomous-integration-fabric-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  local-proof:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - name: Checkout trusted code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Set up exact Node runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.2'
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Run autonomous integration unit and isolation tests
        run: node --test integration/runtime/autonomous-integration-hub.test.cjs

      - name: Run directory discovery worker safety tests
        run: node --test integration/worker/directory-discovery-worker.test.cjs

      - name: Re-run identity survival regression
        run: node --test security/runtime/identity-survival-guard.test.cjs

      - name: Prove integration runtime has no external dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node - <<'NODE'
          const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const Module = require('node:module');
          const builtins = new Set(Module.builtinModules.flatMap(x => [x, `node:${x}`]));
          builtins.add('node:sqlite');
          const sources = [
            fs.readFileSync('integration/runtime/autonomous-integration-hub.cjs', 'utf8'),
            fs.readFileSync('integration/worker/directory-discovery-worker.cjs', 'utf8')
          ];
          const external = [];
          for (const source of sources) {
            for (const re of [/require\(['"]([^'"]+)['"]\)/g, /from\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g]) {
              let match;
              while ((match = re.exec(source))) {
                const spec = match[1];
                if (spec.startsWith('.') || builtins.has(spec)) continue;
                external.push(spec);
              }
            }
          }
          assert.deepEqual(external, [], 'Integration fabric introduced an unreviewed external module.');
          NODE

      - name: Build exact guarded staging image with integration fabric
        run: docker build --pull=false -t wfm-integration-fabric:${{ github.sha }} .

      - name: Exercise discovery to validated active connection over real HTTP
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          image="wfm-integration-fabric:${GITHUB_SHA}"
          password='Integration-Fabric-CI-Only-2026-Long!'
          internal='integration-worker-ci-token'
          cid="$(docker run -d --rm             -p 127.0.0.1:38119:3000             -e PORT=3000             -e WFM_HOSTED_STAGING=true             -e WFM_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://staging.integration.test             -e WFM_STAGING_PASSWORD="$password"             -e WFM_DB=/tmp/wfm-integration.sqlite             -e WFM_INTEGRATION_INTERNAL_TOKEN="$internal"             "$image")"
          trap 'docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT

          ready=0
          for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
            code="$(curl -sS -o /tmp/health.json -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:38119/api/health 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ "$code" = '200' ]; then ready=1; break; fi
            sleep 0.2
          done
          test "$ready" = '1'

          login_code="$(curl -sS -D /tmp/login.headers -o /tmp/login.body -w '%{http_code}'             -H 'Host: staging.integration.test'             -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https'             -H 'Origin: https://staging.integration.test'             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"email\":\"manager@northstar.example\",\"password\":\"$password\"}"             http://127.0.0.1:38119/api/login)"
          test "$login_code" = '200'
          cookie="$(awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^set-cookie:/ {gsub("\\r",""); print $2; exit}' /tmp/login.headers | cut -d';' -f1)"
          test -n "$cookie"

          curl -sSf             -H 'Host: staging.integration.test'             -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https'             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             http://127.0.0.1:38119/api/integrations/autonomous/status >/tmp/status.json

          curl -sSf             -H 'Host: staging.integration.test'             -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https'             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data '{"source":"ENTRA","apps":[{"appId":"wd-ci","displayName":"Workday Production"},{"appId":"ns-ci","displayName":"Oracle NetSuite"}]}'             http://127.0.0.1:38119/api/integrations/autonomous/discover >/tmp/discover.json

          candidate_id="$(node -e "const d=require('/tmp/discover.json');const c=d.candidates.find(x=>x.productKey==='workday');if(!c)process.exit(2);process.stdout.write(c.id)")"
          test -n "$candidate_id"

          curl -sSf             -H 'Host: staging.integration.test'             -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https'             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"candidateId\":\"$candidate_id\",\"authoritativeFor\":[\"people\",\"absence\"]}"             http://127.0.0.1:38119/api/integrations/autonomous/confirm >/tmp/confirm.json

          curl -sSf             -H 'Host: staging.integration.test'             -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https'             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"candidateId\":\"$candidate_id\",\"authMethod\":\"oauth2\",\"sourceInstanceId\":\"workday-ci\"}"             http://127.0.0.1:38119/api/integrations/autonomous/connect >/tmp/connect.json

          connection_id="$(node -e "const d=require('/tmp/connect.json');if(d.connection.state!=='AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED')process.exit(2);process.stdout.write(d.connection.id)")"
          test -n "$connection_id"

          curl -sSf             -H 'Host: staging.integration.test'             -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https'             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H "X-WFM-Integration-Internal: $internal"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"connectionId\":\"$connection_id\",\"authorizationRef\":\"vault://ci/workday\",\"grantedScopes\":[\"people.read\",\"absence.read\"]}"             http://127.0.0.1:38119/api/integrations/autonomous/authorize-complete >/tmp/authorize.json

          curl -sSf             -H 'Host: staging.integration.test'             -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https'             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"connectionId\":\"$connection_id\",\"mappings\":[{\"sourceField\":\"employee_id\",\"canonicalField\":\"employeeId\",\"confidence\":1},{\"sourceField\":\"first_name\",\"canonicalField\":\"firstName\",\"confidence\":1},{\"sourceField\":\"last_name\",\"canonicalField\":\"lastName\",\"confidence\":1}]}"             http://127.0.0.1:38119/api/integrations/autonomous/mapping-activate >/tmp/mapping.json

          curl -sSf             -H 'Host: staging.integration.test'             -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https'             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H "X-WFM-Integration-Internal: $internal"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"connectionId\":\"$connection_id\",\"records\":[{\"employee_id\":\"E-100\",\"first_name\":\"A\",\"last_name\":\"One\"},{\"employee_id\":\"E-101\",\"first_name\":\"B\",\"last_name\":\"Two\"}]}"             http://127.0.0.1:38119/api/integrations/autonomous/sync-validate >/tmp/sync.json

          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const sync = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/sync.json', 'utf8'));
          if (sync.connection.state !== 'ACTIVE' || sync.reconciliation.status !== 'PASS') {
            throw new Error('Connection did not become ACTIVE after trusted validation.');
          }
          NODE

          curl -sSf             -H 'Host: staging.integration.test'             -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https'             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             http://127.0.0.1:38119/api/integrations/autonomous/status >/tmp/final-status.json

          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const status = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/final-status.json', 'utf8'));
          if (!status.readiness.readyForPeopleSync) throw new Error('People sync readiness did not turn true.');
          if (status.readiness.needsAdminAction !== 0) throw new Error('Unexpected admin action remains.');
          console.log('AUTONOMOUS_INTEGRATION_HTTP_PROOF=PASS');
          NODE

  hosted-railway-proof:
    needs: local-proof
    if: github.repository == 'paulallen123/-manufacturing-wfm' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/feature/autonomous-integration-fabric-v1'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      RAILWAY_NO_AUTO_UPDATE: '1'
      RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID: '9a774359-37fa-47e8-bde0-932420c32923'
      RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID: '6a33f2c1-bedd-46dc-85e7-2ef5d3b54de6'
      RAILWAY_SERVICE_ID: '2631d462-61bf-4c01-ac4b-e106a562feeb'
      HOSTED_BASE_URL: 'https://wfm-integration-fabric-v1-proof-production.up.railway.app'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout tested branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Install pinned Railway CLI
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          CLI_URL='https://github.com/railwayapp/cli/releases/download/v5.57.8/railway-v5.57.8-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz'
          CLI_SHA256='43bc4f0385af68cfecaff09efbf5a933a87df728e01d77cb5613c30b74ac3d9d'
          curl --fail --location --silent --show-error "$CLI_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/railway.tgz"
          echo "$CLI_SHA256  $RUNNER_TEMP/railway.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/railway-cli"
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/railway.tgz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/railway-cli"
          CLI_BIN="$(find "$RUNNER_TEMP/railway-cli" -type f -name railway -perm -u+x | head -n 1)"
          test -n "$CLI_BIN"
          echo "RAILWAY_BIN=$CLI_BIN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$CLI_BIN" --version

      - name: Upload tested source to isolated proof service
        env:
          RAILWAY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_TOKEN }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "${RAILWAY_TOKEN:-}" || { echo 'RAILWAY_TOKEN repository secret is not configured.' >&2; exit 1; }
          "$RAILWAY_BIN" up --ci             --project "$RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID"             --environment "$RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID"             --service "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_ID"             -m "autonomous integration fabric proof ${GITHUB_SHA}"

      - name: Prove hosted discovery and connection lifecycle
        env:
          RAILWAY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_TOKEN }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          vars_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/integration-proof-vars.json"
          "$RAILWAY_BIN" variable list             --service "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_ID"             --environment "$RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID"             --json > "$vars_file"

          mapfile -t proof_values < <(node - "$vars_file" <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const vars = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
          if (!vars.WFM_STAGING_PASSWORD || !vars.WFM_INTEGRATION_INTERNAL_TOKEN) process.exit(2);
          console.log(vars.WFM_STAGING_PASSWORD);
          console.log(vars.WFM_INTEGRATION_INTERNAL_TOKEN);
          NODE
          )
          password="${proof_values[0]}"
          internal="${proof_values[1]}"
          rm -f "$vars_file"

          ready=0
          for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
            code="$(curl -sS -o /tmp/hosted-health.json -w '%{http_code}' "$HOSTED_BASE_URL/api/health" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ "$code" = '200' ]; then ready=1; break; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          test "$ready" = '1'

          login_code="$(curl -sS -D /tmp/hosted-login.headers -o /tmp/hosted-login.body -w '%{http_code}'             -H "Origin: $HOSTED_BASE_URL"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"email\":\"manager@northstar.example\",\"password\":\"$password\"}"             "$HOSTED_BASE_URL/api/login")"
          test "$login_code" = '200'
          cookie="$(awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^set-cookie:/ {gsub("\\r",""); print $2; exit}' /tmp/hosted-login.headers | cut -d';' -f1)"
          test -n "$cookie"

          curl -sSf -H "Cookie: $cookie" "$HOSTED_BASE_URL/api/integrations/autonomous/status" >/tmp/hosted-status.json

          curl -sSf             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data '{"source":"ENTRA","apps":[{"appId":"wd-hosted","displayName":"Workday Production"},{"appId":"ns-hosted","displayName":"Oracle NetSuite"}]}'             "$HOSTED_BASE_URL/api/integrations/autonomous/discover" >/tmp/hosted-discover.json

          candidate_id="$(node -e "const d=require('/tmp/hosted-discover.json');const c=d.candidates.find(x=>x.productKey==='workday');if(!c)process.exit(2);process.stdout.write(c.id)")"
          test -n "$candidate_id"

          curl -sSf             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"candidateId\":\"$candidate_id\",\"authoritativeFor\":[\"people\",\"absence\"]}"             "$HOSTED_BASE_URL/api/integrations/autonomous/confirm" >/tmp/hosted-confirm.json

          curl -sSf             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"candidateId\":\"$candidate_id\",\"authMethod\":\"oauth2\",\"sourceInstanceId\":\"workday-hosted-proof\"}"             "$HOSTED_BASE_URL/api/integrations/autonomous/connect" >/tmp/hosted-connect.json

          connection_id="$(node -e "const d=require('/tmp/hosted-connect.json');if(d.connection.state!=='AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED')process.exit(2);process.stdout.write(d.connection.id)")"
          test -n "$connection_id"

          curl -sSf             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H "X-WFM-Integration-Internal: $internal"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"connectionId\":\"$connection_id\",\"authorizationRef\":\"vault://railway-proof/workday\",\"grantedScopes\":[\"people.read\",\"absence.read\"]}"             "$HOSTED_BASE_URL/api/integrations/autonomous/authorize-complete" >/tmp/hosted-authorize.json

          curl -sSf             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"connectionId\":\"$connection_id\",\"mappings\":[{\"sourceField\":\"employee_id\",\"canonicalField\":\"employeeId\",\"confidence\":1},{\"sourceField\":\"first_name\",\"canonicalField\":\"firstName\",\"confidence\":1},{\"sourceField\":\"last_name\",\"canonicalField\":\"lastName\",\"confidence\":1}]}"             "$HOSTED_BASE_URL/api/integrations/autonomous/mapping-activate" >/tmp/hosted-mapping.json

          curl -sSf             -H "Cookie: $cookie"             -H "X-WFM-Integration-Internal: $internal"             -H 'Content-Type: application/json'             --data "{\"connectionId\":\"$connection_id\",\"records\":[{\"employee_id\":\"E-HOST-100\",\"first_name\":\"A\",\"last_name\":\"One\"},{\"employee_id\":\"E-HOST-101\",\"first_name\":\"B\",\"last_name\":\"Two\"}]}"             "$HOSTED_BASE_URL/api/integrations/autonomous/sync-validate" >/tmp/hosted-sync.json

          node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const sync = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/hosted-sync.json', 'utf8'));
          if (sync.connection.state !== 'ACTIVE' || sync.reconciliation.status !== 'PASS') {
            throw new Error('Hosted connection did not become ACTIVE after trusted validation.');
          }
          console.log('HOSTED_AUTONOMOUS_INTEGRATION_PROOF=PASS');
          NODE
